name: kkce/kk-content-exporter
description: KK Content Exporter: exposes published WordPress content as configurable, read-only JSON feeds.

scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check (php -l) of every first-party PHP file
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at the level set in phpstan.neon.dist
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Unit tests (PHPUnit + Brain Monkey, no WordPress)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration tests (WordPress test suite, dedicated database; see tests/integration/README.md)
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Unit and integration tests in order
scripts-descriptions.make-json: Write the JSON translations of the admin scripts from every languages/*.po
scripts-descriptions.i18n: make-pot, update-po, make-mo and make-json in order
scripts-descriptions.hooks:install: Activate the Git hooks of .githooks/ in this clone
scripts-descriptions.build:zip: Build build/kk-content-exporter-<version>.zip (clean tree, checks, .distignore, verification); options after --: --allow-dirty, --skip-checks
scripts-descriptions.svn:prepare: Prepare the WordPress.org SVN working copy from the build (dry run by default; --apply; never commits)
scripts-descriptions.check: lint, phpcs, phpstan and unit tests (the fast local gate)
